/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd, re
fe = pd.read_excel('national_programme_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
sal = pd.read_excel('national_programme_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup = pd.read_excel('national_programme_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

def norm(s):
    if pd.isna(s): return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()

def parse_amount(v):
    if pd.isna(v): return 0
    if isinstance(v, (int,float)): return float(v)
    digits = re.sub(r'["'^0-9]'"','', str(v))
    return float(digits) if digits else 0

lookup_map = {}
for _, r in lookup.iterrows():
    code = norm(r['Cost Centre Code'])
    lookup_map[code] = (str(r['Programme']).strip(), str(r['State']).strip())

fe['cc_norm'] = fe['Cost Centre'].apply(norm)
fe['status_norm'] = fe['Posting Status'].apply(norm)
fe['amt'] = fe['Amount (INR)'].apply(parse_amount)

sal['cc_norm'] = sal['Cost Centre'].apply(norm)
sal['status_norm'] = sal['Payroll Status'].apply(norm)
sal['amt'] = sal['Gross Salary (INR)'].apply(parse_amount)

def filter_df(df, status_val):
    m = df['status_norm']==status_val
    m &= df['cc_norm'].isin(lookup_map)
    # map programme/state
    prog_state = df['cc_norm'].map(lambda c: lookup_map.get(c))
    # create mask
    mask = m & prog_state.apply(lambda x: x[0]=='Maternal and Child Health' and x[1]=='Odisha' if isinstance(x,tuple) else False)
    return df[mask]['amt'].sum()

total = filter_df(fe,'posted') + filter_df(sal,'paid')
print(total)
\"
"
